step_descriptor: run_held_out.py contract parser dropped confidence for 8/30 month_0 records — the model leaked the confidence value as text into direct_answer ("...</parameter><parameter name=confidence>0.15") so stated_confidence was written null; compute_ece then excluded them, removing 2 of 3 real negatives and inflating A1 (accuracy 0.85->0.923, ECE_raw 0.51->0.582)
trigger: closing composite-audit (ADR-0037), Sonnet auditor reading the raw month_0 records
error_feedback: the producing agent self-review did NOT catch it; only the adversarial multi-provider panel did (§7: self-audit is not a gate)
resolution: forward fix _recover_leaked_confidence() in run_held_out.py + rescore (reports/ece_month0_corrected_20260711.json); corrected A1 to n=20 / accuracy 0.85 / ECE_raw 0.51

step_descriptor: LLM judge panel (text-only, no tools) fabricated verification narratives — 11/18 Level-2 verdicts claimed "3/3 live-Ensembl spot-checks resolved correctly / the raw cache exists", acts the judge is structurally incapable of performing; rewards the APPEARANCE of grounding
error_feedback: LLM-judge quality is not ground truth; a same-vendor panel cannot catch shared bias
resolution: MITIGATED (ADR-0038): judge is now handed the deterministic verify_output result + forbidden to claim unexecuted verification; cross-provider gpt-4o judge added.
